title: Why is snow white?
examples: Teacher, why does snow look so white?
What makes snow reflect light so well?
Does the shape of snow change how white it is?

explain.say: Snow is made of tiny pieces of ice.
These tiny pieces are called ice crystals.
When light hits the crystals, it bounces off in every direction.
All that bouncing light makes snow look bright and white.
On a sunny day, snow can be so bright that you need sunglasses.

draw.text: Real life: bright snow on a sunny day

explain.say: A common mistake is to think snow is always white. Dirty snow can look grey or brown.

draw.text: Mistake: thinking all snow is white

faq.a: Snow is white because its tiny ice crystals bounce all the colours of light around. Together, all the colours look white.

faq.q: Does the shape of the snow matter?
faq.a: Yes, the shape of the ice crystals helps them scatter the light very well. Different shapes can change how much light bounces off.

faq.q: Can snow look white even if it is dirty?
faq.a: No. Dirty snow soaks up some light and looks grey or brown. Clean snow bounces all the light around, so it looks white.
asks: Why is dirty snow not white?

faq.q: Is the light scattering the only reason it is white?
faq.a: Each ice crystal is clear, like glass. Snow looks white because light bounces between lots of crystals.

faq.q: Does the sun's strength change how white the snow is?
faq.a: More sunlight makes the snow look brighter. It still looks white.
asks: Does the sun make snow whiter?
Can snow look different in different light?

facts: Snow is made up of many small ice crystals.
These crystals are very good at scattering sunlight.
Scattering light makes the snow appear bright white.
If snow gets dirty, it soaks up some light and changes colour.

options.show: light bounces off the ice in every direction
options.say: light bounces off the ice in every direction

quiz.why: Light bounces off the tiny crystals in every direction. That makes snow look white.

wrong.0: Cold makes snow, but light makes it look white.
wrong.2: Snow falls from clouds, but light makes it look white.

quiz.say: Snow gets covered in dirt from the road. How does it look?
quiz.why: Dirt soaks up some light, so the snow looks grey or brown.

wrong.1: Dirt makes snow darker, not brighter.
wrong.2: Dirt makes snow grey or brown.

quiz.say: Look at one tiny ice crystal on its own. What does it look like?
quiz.why: One crystal is clear. Lots of crystals together look white.

wrong.0: Lots of crystals look white together, but one alone is clear.
wrong.1: Ice crystals have no red colour.
